## Install

1. Download **ClipHistory-….dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **Clip History** onto **Applications**.
3. Open Clip History from Applications. It is not notarized by Apple yet, so the first time macOS
   says it cannot verify the app. Click **Done**, open **System Settings › Privacy & Security**,
   scroll down and click **Open Anyway**, then **Open**. This is needed only once.
4. Allow **Accessibility** when asked, so ↩ can paste for you.

Press **⇧⌘V** to open the history. Works on macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon and Intel.

**Updating:** quit Clip History, drag the new version onto Applications and replace the old one.
macOS asks for Accessibility again after an update: in System Settings › Privacy & Security ›
Accessibility, remove Clip History with − and switch it on again when asked.
